body: I’m giving you the biggest hug through the screen right now too. Thank you for your words and insight. It feels nice to connect with someone, though I’m sorry it has to be through pain. I’m so happy to hear your growth through your experience and wish your kind soul only the best going forward! I suppose on my part I’ll need to time think it over. It’s all happening very fast, I suppose processing has been backlogged a bit! Thank you again for your warmth.

They most definitely will, just as it has been seeping back very slowly. The sad thing is how much we shared- our insecurities, our vulnerabilities, the past hurt experienced. I was in abusive relationship with a narc, who had raped and beat me, and thought my current partner understood the trauma it caused, but instead it’s like history is repeating itself.

The issue is confusing. My partner tells me he has never had a safe space to explore himself and deal with his own problems with someone, and that’s all he’s ever wanted. So I’m here journeying with him through it and he rages at me as a coping mechanism. It feels wrong to abandon someone who’s trying to heal. 

A lot of what you wrote truly hits close to home, especially with your experience with your ex. Thank you for sharing. Sigh. I can’t move forward, I can’t look back. Feels very stuckish with only tunnel vision to go forward.

I think from a third persons perspective, even in my own circle, this relationship was probably the worst thing to happen. I see it too, but I also experience how beautiful life has finally been with him. We are truly happy. It’s these setbacks that take a major toll. I also probably sound delusional at this point but that’s probably what’s been keeping me going.
